about.author: Author
about.description: Chitach is a free and open-source application for reading Serbian electronic documents: identity cards, health insurance cards and vehicle registration certificates.
about.privacy: Card data is processed locally, on your computer only.
autoSave.error.nonDirectory: Autosave location is not a directory
certs.pinDesc: The PIN protects the certificates on the identity card. It gets blocked after three consecutive wrong attempts.
certs.subtitle: Cryptographic elements of the identity card

crypto.wrongCard: Cryptographic elements are not available on this card

fines.category.person: Traffic offences and court fines — bound to the person, not the vehicle
fines.consent.details: Only the plate is sent, with one request per check. The result is kept in memory only (30 min) and never sent to third parties. If you use the app for business purposes, you are the data controller under the Serbian data protection law. You can revoke consent in the settings.
fines.consent.text: Chitach will send the vehicle plate %s to the following official portals:
fines.consent.title: Automatic fines check
fines.payOnPortal: Fines are paid and disputed on the issuer's portal. For information only.
fines.plateCopiedHint: Paste it into the plate field on the portal.
fines.privacy: Chitach does not store this data. An automatic check sends only the plate, directly to the official portal.
fines.provider.bg-parking.name: Belgrade – Parking servis (eDPK)
fines.provider.bg-parking.note: eDPK tickets from the last 60 days. The page is protected by a human check — enter the plate yourself.
fines.provider.ca-parking.name: Čačak – Parking servis
fines.provider.ca-parking.note: Checked by ticket number, not by plate.
fines.provider.enp.name: Road toll – ENP / Toll4All account
fines.provider.enp.note: There is no public toll check by plate; passages and debts are shown in your TAG account.
fines.provider.euprava-prekrsaji.name: eUprava – Traffic offences overview
fines.provider.euprava-prekrsaji.note: Offences, penalty points and orders of the signed-in person. Sign in with ConsentID or the ID card certificate.
fines.provider.kg-sumadija.name: Kragujevac – JKP “Šumadija”
fines.provider.kg-sumadija.note: Check of daily parking tickets by plate.
fines.provider.nis-parking.name: Niš – Parking servis (eDPK)
fines.provider.nis-parking.note: Menu “eDPK provera”, tickets from the last 60 days.
fines.provider.np-parking.name: Novi Pazar – Parking servis (ParkingNS portal)
fines.provider.np-parking.note: Field “Registarska oznaka” (e.g. NP123AB), button “Provera”. Payment instructions only for tickets from the last year; the data is informative.
fines.provider.parkingns.name: Novi Sad – ParkingNS portal (ePPK)
fines.provider.parkingns.note: Electronic parking tickets by plate; reportedly used by other cities too. Supports the automatic check.
fines.provider.pk-parking.name: Prokuplje
fines.provider.rnk.name: Register of unpaid fines
fines.provider.rnk.note: Final unpaid fines. Requires name, surname and personal number — Chitach never sends them automatically.
fines.provider.zlatibor-parking.name: Zlatibor / Čajetina – KJP “Zlatibor” (eDPK)
fines.provider.zr-parking.name: Zrenjanin – JKP “Pijace i parkinzi” (ePPK)
fines.provider.zr-parking.note: Check of electronic parking tickets by plate.
fines.statusHint.manual: The portal does not allow an automatic check — open it and check manually
fines.statusHint.parseError: The portal may have changed its response format — check manually
fines.statusHint.unavailable: The portal is not reachable right now, try again later
fines.subtitle: Official portals for checking unpaid parking tickets and other fines
fines.tip: For ongoing notifications use the parking operator's official app.
fines.title: Fines check
id.birthPlace: Place of birth, municipality and country
id.name: Name, parent name, surname
medical.dateNote: * Expiration date on card may not be updated. Press 'Update' to refresh this information from RFZO's online service. This action requires internet access.
medical.validationNote: The verification date stored on the card may be outdated. “Update verification” fetches the current value from the RFZO service (requires internet).
pinChange.confirmNewPinFormatError: Format of the confirmed new PIN is not valid.
pinChange.error: An error occurred. Do not try to change the PIN again until the card is checked.
pinChange.newPinFormatError: Format of the new PIN is not valid.
pinChange.oldPinFormatError: Format of the old PIN is not valid.
pinChange.pinFormatExplanation: PIN must hold between 4 and 8 digits.
pinChange.title: Change PIN
preference.pkcsLoadError: Error occurred while loading PKCS#11 module. Check the module path.
preference.startAgain: Restart application to see changes applied.
preference.title: Preferences
settings.autoSaveDesc: The document is saved automatically right after the card is read.
settings.checkUpdatesDesc: Check for a new version on startup.
settings.finesAutoCheckDesc: When a vehicle card is read, the plate is sent to the selected portals (at most once per 30 minutes).
settings.finesConsentGivenDesc: The plate may be sent to the automatic-check portals.
settings.finesConsentNotGivenDesc: It will be asked for before the first automatic check.
settings.finesDesc: A panel on the vehicle registration card with official portals for checking fines. Portals open in the browser; the automatic check is optional.
settings.finesProviderDesc: Automatic check — the plate is sent to %s
settings.finesRemoteDesc: Once a day, downloads the signed portal list from GitHub so new cities and fixes arrive without a new version. No personal data is sent.
settings.modeDesc: Changing the mode takes effect after restart.
settings.pdfScriptDesc: Script used for field labels in PDF.
settings.pkcs11Desc: Paths to PKCS#11 libraries used for signing and Smartbox. Leave empty to use the default path.
settings.runInBackgroundDesc: The application stays in the system tray when the window is closed.
settings.subtitle: Customize how the application looks and behaves.
smartbox.error: Error occurred while starting Smartbox server
smartbox.howTo: Open the ePorezi portal in your browser and choose smart card login. Keep Chitach running while you use the portal.
smartbox.subtitle: A local server through which the ePorezi portal uses your card for login and signing.
smartbox.title: Smartbox (ePorezi)
state.error.desc: Make sure the card is inserted properly and try again.
state.noReader.hint: The reader will be detected automatically once connected.
state.reading.desc: Do not remove the card until reading is finished.
state.unknown.desc: The card in the reader is not supported. If you think it should be, please report its ATR.
state.waiting.desc: Identity cards, health insurance cards and vehicle registration certificates are supported. Data is read automatically as soon as the card is inserted.
state.waiting.title: Insert a card into the reader
xmlSign.noCerts: There are no certificates on the token.
xmlSign.noSlots: No token found. Insert a card or token and refresh.
xmlSign.pinWarning: Warning: three wrong PINs will lock the token.
xmlSign.subtitle: Sign an XML document (e.g. a tax return) with a certificate from a smart card or token.
xmlSign.title: Sign XML document
